statusDetail: Cloudflare Managed Challenge intercepted raw-CDP Chrome on the homepage and representative category route. Human verification cannot be completed by this unattended audit, so no target-site check could be judged.

page.notes: robots.txt and sitemap.xml were reachable, but all browser-rendered target pages tested were replaced by a Cloudflare “Just a moment...” human-verification challenge.
